nodes.label: main() / ruby_run_node
nodes.desc: C entry point: calls ruby_run_node(ruby_options(argc, argv)) (main.c L42), defined at main.c L52.

nodes.label: prism_script
nodes.desc: Prism is the default parser (RB_DEFAULT_PARSER_PRISM, version.c L194); prism_script parses the script into a Prism AST (ruby.c L2231).

nodes.label: parser_yylex
nodes.desc: Lexer of the legacy parse.y LALR grammar, still selectable via --parser=parse.y (ruby.c L373); parser_yylex at parse.y L10488.

nodes.label: rb_iseq_compile_node
nodes.desc: Recursively compiles NODE AST into YARV instruction sequences (compile.c L901); per-node work in iseq_compile_each0 (compile.c L11139).

nodes.label: pm_iseq_compile_node
nodes.desc: Compiles the Prism AST into the same YARV instruction sequences (prism_compile.c L10685); pm_compile_node at prism_compile.c L8803.

nodes.label: vm_exec (rb_vm_exec)
nodes.desc: The VM loop entry: pushes tags, runs jit_exec or vm_exec_core, then unwinds exceptions in vm_exec_loop (vm.c L2891, L2932); exposed as rb_vm_exec by the macro at vm.c L10.

nodes.label: vm_exec_core
nodes.desc: The interpreter inner loop: pins pc and cfp to machine registers (x86_64 r14/r15, vm_exec.c L50-52) and jumps through vm.inc tables generated from insns.def (vm_exec.c L92-94).

nodes.label: opt_send_without_block
nodes.desc: The method-call instruction (insns.def L902) that feeds vm_sendish; siblings include putobject (L350) and branchif (L1262).

nodes.label: vm_call_method
nodes.desc: Visibility check then type-dispatch for every call (vm_insnhelper.c L5128); vm_call_method_each_type switches on ISEQ/CFUNC/ATTRSET/IVAR/... (vm_insnhelper.c L4989).

nodes.label: callable_method_entry_or_negative
nodes.desc: Per-class call-cache fast path reads RCLASS_WRITABLE_CC_TBL lock-free (vm_method.c L2132, fast path L2151-2165); misses take the VM lock, walk search_method (vm_method.c L1942) and cache negative results too (L2183).

nodes.label: gc_start
nodes.desc: Entry of the modular default GC (gc/default/default.c L9018): incremental gc_marks_step (L8134) and lazy gc_sweep_step (L5871) over heap pages from heap_page_allocate (L3003).

nodes.label: rb_thread_schedule
nodes.desc: Yields the running thread once its time slice runs out (thread.c L1695, limits at L1676-1692), saving machine context and switching via the per-Ractor scheduler.
